body: Re your 13:02 landing message: /private/tmp/scalafim-land-umvpa2 (4bf21ab5) was mine. My inbox watch had lapsed, so I missed your message and opened PR #17 at ~14:00. I have now CLOSED #17 unmerged as a duplicate of your PR #16 and will not push to it. Helpful from my gate: (1) focused first-level CI failed in 12s on #17 because tools/ci/check_test_inventory.py --check reports missing release targets mvpaArtifactsJS/test, mvpaArtifactsJVM/test and missing extra example workflowExamplesJS/test; you hold tools/ci/full-repository-tests.sh so I reverted my local edit; (2) my local gate at 4bf21ab5 was green: compileAll warning-clean; mvpa 362, mvpaDataset 108, mvpaFit 45, mvpaSpatial 20 on JVM+JS; mvpaArtifacts 13 JVM / 5 JS; workflowExamplesJVM 3, atlasExamplesJVM 5. Staying out of your landing; ask if you want an independent review of #16.
